The pricing page lists context caching as a paid-tier feature, so the core of documented prefix caching tied to pricing is present. missing for 10: specific cache-hit token prices or discount rates, evidence of latency reduction, details on explicit/managed cache creation and TTL/storage pricing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
